name: Ghostwriter
tagline: Turn your RSS feeds into readable e-books with AI summaries
description:
Ghostwriter turns your RSS feeds into something more like a proper reading session. It converts your subscriptions into EPUB-style reading material, complete with AI-generated summaries and podcast-style digests, so you can catch up in a calmer, more book-like format.

It runs on a self-hosted backend that also handles syncing, so your reading position and summaries follow you across devices.
